title: Duchy of Kuyavia
capsule: Attested in our geometric sources A prior capsule was withdrawn in source review; an accurate one is pending.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The duchy's existence and rough territory are attested in Polish chronicles and ducal charters, but the exact boundaries of this relatively minor principality are reconstructed from later administrative records and carry moderate uncertainty.
